def: of uncertain derivation); a rushlet, i.e. grass-withe or tie (generally)

occurrences.text: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;
Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.
